email.subject: Smile Group's site is losing new patients
email.body:
Hi Elena,

I took a quick look at Smile Group Dentistry's website. Two things are likely costing you new patients: there's no way to book an appointment online, so anyone searching after hours just moves to the next dentist, and the site isn't mobile-friendly, which matters since most local searches happen on phones. I also noticed no patient reviews on the site and a footer with outdated info.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee, no contracts. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough and show you exactly what I'd change.

Worth a quick call this week?

Alex
